name: Monumental Minerals Corp.
summary: Monumental Energy Corp. is an early-stage company based in Vancouver and founded in 2020, identifying and developing mineral properties in Chile. It explores for cesium and lithium, with an option on 75% of the Laguna Project near San Pedro de Atacama and a 50.01% interest in the Turi project in the Lithium Triangle. It also invests in oil and gas extraction.
